scope_note: Filterable Social Perception working dataset. Public-evidence records are sourced from publicly accessible company/social pages found on the open web. Demo-baseline records are synthetic placeholders used only to keep unavailable-platform filters functional and must never be represented as live social-listening data.

records.title: Quest extends oncology test access through OncoEMR integration
records.summary: Quest highlighted integration of Haystack MRD and comprehensive genomic profiling into OncoEMR workflows, positioning advanced molecular testing closer to community oncology decision-making.

records.title: Whole exome sequencing advances highlighted
records.summary: Quest used educational content to emphasize whole exome sequencing as a faster route to answers and more targeted care, reinforcing a genomics-led innovation narrative.

records.title: Corporate responsibility and healthier-world narrative
records.summary: Quest promoted its corporate responsibility agenda around access, impact and healthier communities, supporting a broad trust-and-purpose brand narrative beyond testing alone.

records.title: Tick-borne disease testing guidance amplified
records.summary: Quest shared testing guidance for tick-borne disease, using clinical education to reinforce its role as a trusted diagnostic information source for providers and patients.

records.title: Quest Diagnostics official video channel
records.summary: Quest maintains an official video presence that can support education, corporate storytelling and diagnostic awareness, although the repository does not currently ingest video-level metrics automatically.

records.title: Consumer genetics and personalized-health messaging
records.summary: Labcorp promoted OnDemand genetics content around genetic health, personalized health and health insights, strengthening its direct-to-consumer narrative.

records.title: ADLM innovation and laboratory strategy
records.summary: Labcorp used conference-oriented messaging to position laboratory innovation around expanding capabilities, improving efficiency and increasing value for laboratory customers.

records.title: Whole-genome sequencing collaboration in oncology
records.summary: Labcorp emphasized collaboration on whole-genome sequencing and MRD applications, reinforcing scale, access and precision-oncology positioning.

records.title: Labcorp official video channel
records.summary: Labcorp maintains a public video channel that can support product education and corporate communication, but automated video-performance monitoring is not configured in this repository.

records.title: Autoimmune neurology testing education
records.summary: Mayo Clinic Laboratories highlighted phenotype-specific autoimmune neurology testing, reinforcing specialist clinical authority and test-selection education.

records.title: Precision epilepsy testing speed and accuracy
records.summary: Mayo promoted same-day or next-day precision epilepsy testing, connecting specialty diagnostics with faster physician decision-making.

records.title: AI augmentation in laboratory medicine
records.summary: Mayo framed AI as an augmentation tool for routine laboratory tasks, emphasizing workforce productivity, quality and clinician support rather than automation for its own sake.

records.title: Applied AI in laboratory medicine
records.summary: ARUP promoted practical AI use in diagnostic testing and clinician support, positioning the organization around applied innovation with a human-centered laboratory focus.

records.title: Data-led laboratory stewardship
records.summary: ARUP emphasized analytics-enabled stewardship to reduce waste, improve care and sharpen laboratory business strategy for health-system clients.

records.title: Companion diagnostic partnership with CellCarta
records.summary: Sonic highlighted a collaboration to expand companion diagnostic testing and clinical-trial support, strengthening its precision-medicine and research-network narrative.

records.title: National healthcare partnership positioning
records.summary: Sonic emphasized partnership-led laboratory solutions, operational excellence and diagnostic access across healthcare organizations nationwide.

records.title: Medical leadership summit narrative
records.summary: Sonic used its Medical Leadership Summit to reinforce clinical leadership, collaboration and the future direction of diagnostic medicine.

records.title: PTEN companion diagnostic promoted
records.summary: NeoGenomics highlighted an FDA-approved PTEN companion diagnostic for metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer, reinforcing therapy-linked oncology testing.

records.title: Population-scale cancer data message
records.summary: NeoGenomics promoted a dataset representing millions of patient profiles, strengthening its real-world-data and oncology intelligence positioning.

records.title: MRD portfolio and RaDaR narrative
records.summary: NeoGenomics continued to emphasize MRD and tumor-informed monitoring as strategic oncology differentiators for clinical trials and treatment decisions.

records.title: Cleveland Clinic AI summit reinforces diagnostics narrative
records.summary: The Cleveland Clinic parent ecosystem promoted AI applications in diagnostics, predictive analytics and clinical workflows, providing a strong innovation halo for its laboratory brand.

records.title: Real-world data in oncology research
records.summary: BioReference has used social content to connect real-world clinical and genomic data with oncology research and pharmaceutical R&D, supporting a data-enabled evidence narrative.
